acip: GNYIS PA LAM DNGOS LA, THEG PA GSUM RANG RANG GI LAM LA TSOGS LAM SOGS LNGA RE YOD LA, MDO SDE SPYOD PA'I DBU MA PA LTAR NA, NYAN RANG GNYIS KAS GTZO BOR NYON SGRIB SPONG BAR MTSUNGS SHING, THOB BYA LA YANG MCHOG DMAN CHER MED KYANG,
wylie: gnyis pa lam dngos la, theg pa gsum rang rang gi lam la tshogs lam sogs lnga re yod la, mdo sde spyod pa'i dbu ma pa ltar na, nyan rang gnyis kas gtso bor nyon sgrib spong bar mtshungs shing, thob bya la yang mchog dman cher med kyang
english: This brings us to our second point from above, on the actual path itself.  Members of the Independent branch of the Middle Way would say that each overall path through each of the three tracks consists itself of five paths, starting with the path of accumulation.  Those of the Independent branch who lean towards the Sutrist system would say that listeners and self-made buddhas are equivalent in the sense that they are, primarily, working to eliminate obstacles to nirvana.  And they would say that there are no great degrees of higher or lower between these two tracks.
